method: Epoch AI frontier data-center timelines: level at each year end from the latest dated observation or projection on or before that date; "now" is the level on the retrieval date; "final" is the last projected level (to 2030). Covers tracked frontier sites only, not whole fleets. Power is Epoch facility power (MW).
users_method: All tracked sites (including owners not mapped to a provider above), credited to the labs Epoch lists as users; a site with several users is split equally, a site without listed users is "Undisclosed user".
